title: Life-Up Heart
wikitext: {{distinguish|MAX UP Heart}} {{item infobox |image=[[File:SMO Artwork Life-Up Heart.png|200px]] |first_appearance=''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]'' ([[2017]]) |latest_appearance=''[[Mario Kart World]]'' (cameo) ([[2025]]) |effect=Increases maximum health by three and restores health to maximum |variant_of=[[Heart (item)|Heart]] |related=[[Life Mushroom]] }} A '''Life-Up Heart''' is a [[List of power-ups|power-up]] item that appears in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. It is the only "traditional" power-up in the game, as for the most part, [[Mario]] gains additional powers through [[Cappy]]'s [[Capture]] ability. A Life-Up Heart serves the same function as a [[Life Mushroom]] from ''[[Super Mario Galaxy]]'' and ''[[Super Mario Galaxy 2]]'': When collected, a Life-Up Heart increases Mario's maximum health to six (nine in Assist Mode) and sets his current health to that maximum; however, if his health is depleted back to three (six in Assist Mode), he loses the three extra pieces of health until another Life-Up Heart is obtained. While Mario's [[Health Meter#Super Mario Odyssey|life meter]] is not at maximum health, a second Life-Up Heart refills his health. If the player collects a Life-Up Heart at maximum health, it grants 10 [[coin]]s instead. Life-Up Hearts can be won from the minigame [[Slots]] and found in [[treasure chest]]s, [[? Block]]s, or various other areas. Only one Life-Up Heart appears in 2D: In the [[Metro Kingdom]]'s [[Metro Kingdom#Bonus areas|Projection Room]], the 2D Life-Up Heart replaces the [[1-Up Mushroom]] within the [[Hidden Block]] in [[World 1-1 (Super Mario Bros.)|World 1-1]] in ''[[Super Mario Bros.]]'' Life-Up Hearts can be [[Crazy Cap#Life-Up Heart|purchased]] from any [[Crazy Cap]] store for 50 regular coins. Crazy Cap stores do not sell Mario a Life-Up Heart if he already has six health points. The item is treated as though it were already purchased. Purchasing a Life-Up Heart leads to the cutscene for boosting Mario's maximum HP even if a prior Life-Up Heart is still in effect. Additionally, as per that cutscene, the shop menu is closed after Mario buys a Life-Up Heart. Also, if Mario gets defeated three times during a boss battle, a Crazy Cap seller appears to sell him a Life-Up Heart. The seller appears only until the boss is defeated. A bonus Life-Up Heart can be obtained by scanning any [[Princess Peach]] [[amiibo]],Nintendo (September 13, 2017). [https://youtu.be/EKWBv-djiKk Super Mario Odyssey - Nintendo Switch - Nintendo Direct 9.13.2017]. ''YouTube''. Retrieved September 13, 2017. with the exception of Cat Peach.
